title: CusCobb
description: Cobblemon Adventure Modpack brings the Pokémon world into Minecraft with immersive exploration, battles, and progression. Catch and train hundreds of Pokémon, challenge powerful trainers, explore unique biomes and structures, and build your ultimate team.
body:
# CusCobb

A carefully curated Cobblemon modpack built for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric), designed to provide a smooth Pokémon adventure experience with exploration, quality-of-life improvements, and performance optimizations.

Build your team, explore vast worlds, challenge powerful trainers, and create your own Pokémon journey while enjoying enhanced gameplay features and improved server performance.

Features
Pokémon gameplay powered by Cobblemon
Multiplayer-friendly experience
Fast travel with Waystones
Minimap and world navigation tools
Improved inventory management
Performance and FPS optimization
Enhanced exploration and world progression
Quality-of-life improvements
Server-ready configuration
Perfect For
Pokémon fans
Multiplayer servers
Survival adventures
Long-term progression
Casual and competitive players
Technical Information
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Mod Loader: Fabric
Server Compatible: Yes
Client Required: Yes
Credits

Full credit goes to the original mod developers whose projects make this modpack possible. Please support the creators of the included mods.
